reviews.text: Dr. Accica and his assistant are fantastic! They are both incredibly professional and have extensive knowledge of domestic animals, especially felines, as I have a cat myself. My son, Filou, is very timid and skittish, but Dr. Accica was able to put him at ease from the very first visit with his kindness and gentleness. He's been treating him for persistent diabetes and gives invaluable advice (he's a 16-year-old cat). We highly recommend this vet and have complete confidence in him.

Dr. Accica is a very attentive and patient doctor, highly professional, and reassuring. He explained my cat's territorial behavior and found a suitable solution. His genuine care for animals is evident. I highly recommend this practice.

We got an appointment very quickly, and both the doctor and the assistant were very attentive. He provided a lot of information about our cat's health and explained the prices before proceeding with the treatment.

A kind, passionate, and animal-loving veterinarian. Very pragmatic in his approach to answering my questions and addressing my needs. He guided me through my cat's final days so that his suffering would be minimized.

I highly recommend the entire staff of this practice for their approach and kindness.

Furthermore, his prices are very reasonable.
Thank you.

I am very satisfied with the consultations with Dr. Accica for my cat. He is extremely kind and attentive, both to the animals and their owners. You really feel like you're in good hands. I highly recommend him!
A huge thank you. If our Cici celebrated its 20th anniversary, it's also thanks to you. In the most difficult moments, when we had to say goodbye, your humanity was a great support to us.

The vet and his assistant are just perfect for our two cats!
They're available, accommodating, and offer great advice.
They took care of our Shiva after her tail was cut off and are finding solutions for our difficult Flocon!
Thank you for them and for all our loyal companions!
I had my cat neutered at this clinic, it went very well, I recommend it.

I came in for a routine vaccination booster for my 3-month-old Rottweiler puppy, and the appointment was very disappointing.

From the outset, the vet offered unsolicited, highly stereotypical training advice about "dominant" dogs, even though I was simply there for a checkup.

The way he handled my puppy was very clumsy and unsettling. He picked him up and put him on the table without asking for my help or trying to reassure him, even though my puppy was clearly anxious. His approach increased his stress instead of calming him down.

Once on the table, my puppy was extremely stressed and nearly fell several times. Each time, I had to catch him. The vet held him roughly by the collar, without any gradual approach or building trust.

This experience was very negative for a puppy of this age and risks creating a negative association with humans and veterinary visits.

I'm very surprised given the good reviews. In any case, I don't recommend this vet. First and last visit.

We wanted to express our sincere gratitude to the doctor and his assistant who were incredibly kind during the euthanasia of our beloved cat. It was a very difficult time, but they provided discreet and compassionate support. Thank you for taking the time to listen to us and for giving us the necessary moment of reflection. Eminem passed away peacefully.

Dr. Accica has been treating my two cats for a year and a half, and I highly recommend him. Very professional, attentive, and passionate about his work, he inspires great confidence. His assistant is equally pleasant and caring. A veterinary practice I recommend without hesitation!
My cat received his vaccinations here, was also microchipped and neutered. Each time, everything went very smoothly. The prices are reasonable for a student. I highly recommend this vet. 👍 …
Dr. Accica is always gentle, kind, professional, and attentive. He has been taking care of my Maltese for over a year, and I completely trust him. I highly recommend him.

A kind, caring, and attentive veterinarian who genuinely loves cats.
I highly recommend him.
Super veto

Since opening their practice, Paolo and Emelyne have cared for our two dogs, now deceased, and our two cats with exceptional attention and kindness. Always available and accommodating, he supported us through every stage of their lives, from moments of joy to the most painful times, with respect and a deep love for animals. We will always be grateful for the care and affection he gave them.
In our experience, this veterinary practice combines professional expertise with genuine compassion. Thank you for the excellent care we provided for our pet.
Paolo is wonderful, very gentle. My cat has been in his excellent hands for three years and is doing wonderfully! He also gives excellent advice.

My two cats, Obi and Raven, have been patients here for years, and I've never been disappointed. The vet is always professional and clear in his explanations, and the assistant is welcoming and attentive.

The care is thorough, the animals are treated gently, and the atmosphere is reassuring at every visit.

It's truly comforting to be able to trust them completely. I highly recommend them.
Very warm welcome and excellent care for my dog.

An exceptional team!
Very attentive and efficient.
Our dogs have been seen by this veterinarian for many years.
I highly recommend them.

Honestly, I'm changing vets.

After more than a year and a half of caring for all our cats since they were kittens, including spaying/neutering, etc., they caught fleas more than nine months ago (!!!) and no solution has been satisfactory.
First, we tried drops, which didn't work. One of the cats started peeling, and... nothing. Thin and hairless, she stayed like that for months. More drops, more visits... nothing. One day, whole worms came out when she returned from the litter box. He didn't warn us about the risk of worm infestation (fleas carry worms...). Tapeworms for all my cats. In a year and a half, we've watched our cats lose weight and develop scabies due to neglect, despite our regular visits. They've never had a booster vaccination. They've never been dewormed before getting tapeworms. If you don't ask, nothing gets done!! But we're not vets. Because of all these (rather serious) shortcomings, our cats experienced a downward spiral of illness that was never addressed, but instead, we accumulated countless visits to this veterinarian (!!). Today, my cats are thin and mangy because after nine months of useless drops, they have all lost their fur, been prescribed even more flea medication (which also doesn't work), continue to scratch, and have scabs—it's hell! For all the cats, who are completely bald, no anti-itch medication was given, and no skin tests were performed to look for other causes. The clinical response was inadequate, delayed, and poorly managed. Nothing is done preventively. You have to come in and say whatever you want, what the problem is, but as long as your cat isn't infested or sick, nothing is done to prevent the risks, and you end up going in for even more illnesses. I'm changing vets, you'll see the photos, it's simply shameful for a professional to let animals get into this state!!! (And for nine months!!)
Two passionate people who truly love animals and take the utmost care of my cat every time they visit. Thank you so much!
One of the very few vets who works with passion, is available and always attentive to everyone's needs. Friendly and professional assistant. Recommended veterinary clinic.

I'm very happy with the welcome and advice. The vet's assistant and the vet themselves took the time to reassure my very fearful puppy and give me helpful tips. They were very attentive. I'll definitely go back! Thank you.
We have been going to Dr Acicca for our dog and cat since we arrived in Lyon in July 2023 and we are very satisfied with the welcome, the different treatments, the advice and the availability.
Top-notch vet! Always available, very competent. He loves animals as well as treating them. And Shane 😺 adores him! …
